style: Three connected paragraphs, 100–200 English words: referral thanks and problem; current symptoms/function and documented change plus delivered treatment and response; what we will focus on next and why. Use short complete sentences and familiar words. Use full treatment terms. No exercise names, equipment or doses. Template findings are never patient facts.
new_user_rules: Include the actual broad treatment modalities, e.g. passive accessory intervertebral mobilisation and strengthening exercise, when documented. Preserve the distinction between delivered care, immediate response and longer-term progress. Patient follow-up is a polite draft asking current symptoms/function and whether review is wanted; no automatic send, no assumed recovery or deterioration. Remove workers compensation/AHTR from this application. Use simple readable English. The final paragraph states our next focus and its purpose, usually in one or two short sentences. Use We will focus on for a recorded plan, We propose focusing on for an inferred direction. Avoid command fragments and vague repeated explanations.
